subject: Late-stage capacity triage — Acuity Labs (AC-8421) GPU hold request
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jul 2029 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Late-stage capacity triage — Acuity Labs (AC-8421) GPU hold request

Team —

Acuity Labs is moving to final POC approval and procurement is asking us to confirm capacity runway. Deal is AC-8421 (see HP link below). Key ask: can we soft-reserve a dedicated pool for the POC window while procurement finalizes MSA? High level details from the customer:

- Window: 2029-08-12 to 2029-09-12 (30 days)
- Target throughput: sustained 120 qps during business hours (US), bursts to 300 qps for scheduled evals
- Preferred footprint: us-west primary, fallback eu-west if needed
- Model family: Llama-3-like, 32k context; they will accept 8-bit quantized variants if latency and quality are within thresholds

Can ops confirm:
1) Available dedicated GPUs (A100-80GB equivalents) for a soft hold for the window above.
2) If we can place a soft hold/standby tag that does not consume billing but guarantees capacity unless we actively release it.
3) Any recommended fallback (quantized slices/tiling) we should offer the customer to reduce unit footprint.

If we can get numbers today, I will share with Acuity and ask procurement to proceed with the MAP. Please include approximate cost delta for dedicated vs. shared pool so AE can price quickly.

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales, Dedicated Accounts
Redwood Inference
https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/AC-8421

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jul 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Late-stage capacity triage — Acuity Labs (AC-8421) GPU hold request

Sean —

Quick capacity snapshot after drilling into fleet usage: attached is the fleet snapshot and a short runbook for soft-holds. TL;DR: we can accommodate the requested window with the following caveats.

Summary availability (as of 2029-07-05 10:30 UTC):
- us-west: 8 A100-80GB equivalent nodes free across the dedicated pool; 6 can be soft-held as a standby for Aug 12 - Sep 12 without impacting current committed pools.
- eu-west: 4 A100-equivalents free but those are needed for a pending internal test on Aug 15 — we can offer eu-west as a fallback with 48-hour notice.

Operational notes / recommendations:
- Put a "soft-standby" tag (internal MR: AC-8421-standby) on 6 A100-equivalents in us-west. This will: preserve node affinity, prevent new long-term reservations on those nodes, and not start billing until activated.
- Offer quantized-8 fallback: swap to 8-bit quantized variants reduces footprint by ~40% on average; helpful if they need more headroom for cost.
- Canary policy: recommend staged activation (2 nodes -> 4 nodes -> full) over 24 hrs to validate perf and KV cache warmup.

Estimated cost delta (30-day window):
- Dedicated soft-standby (6 A100-eq) standby fee: $6,000 (non-billable until activation; administrative hold fee to reserve capacity)
- Activation (fully dedicated): ~$72,000 for 30 days (based on A100-80 eq rate)
- Shared-dedicated (shared reserved pool with priority): ~$45,000 for 30 days

Attachments: runbook_gpu_hold_v1.pdf (how soft-standby works), fleet_snapshot_20290705.csv (raw numbers).

If you want me to tag and lock, give me a green light and I will create AC-8421-standby in the ops portal and notify infra to avoid scheduling patches in that window.

-ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Capacity Planner, Redwood Inference
Attached: runbook_gpu_hold_v1.pdf, fleet_snapshot_20290705.csv

From: Alice Cho <ops@acuitylabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acuitylabs.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 6 Jul 2029 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Late-stage capacity triage — Acuity Labs (AC-8421) GPU hold request

Sean / Ben / Neha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from our side before we confirm the MAP:

1) Sustained load: 120 qps is our daytime steady-state (09:00–18:00 PT). The bursts to 300 qps are short (10–15 minutes) and will occur no more than twice per day during the evaluation.
2) Latency SLO: P99 generation latency must be <= 750ms for 4k token prompts. If quantized-8 adds >100ms P99 we will need to validate quality with a short eval set.
3) Dedicated vs shared: Procurement prefers dedicated nodes during the POC for QA reproducibility, but they will consider shared-dedicated if we can lock capacity and get a formal standby commitment (MAP language).

Procurement note (procurement@acuitylabs.com): we need a short mutual action plan and an MSA redline. Please send a draft MAP and your MSA bullet redlines so our legal can start parallel review.

If you can provision the soft-standby and share the MAP draft, we will proceed to signatures on our side. We understand the standby fee — please also include expected activation lead time from standby to active (hours).

Best,
Alice Cho
Head of Ops, Acuity Labs
ops@acuitylabs.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Cho <ops@acuitylabs.com>, procurement@acuitylabs.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 6 Jul 2029 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Late-stage capacity triage — Acuity Labs (AC-8421) GPU hold request

Alice / team —

Thanks — good color. Ben, please proceed to place the soft-standby tag for 6 A100-equivalents in us-west under MR AC-8421-standby. Dev, can you open the MAP draft and MSA bullets (I added the hubspot link below) and share with Alice and procurement? We should get legal time boxed so procurement can run parallel reviews.

Action items:
- Ben: create AC-8421-standby in ops portal and confirm standby activation lead time (hours). Also add the canary activation steps to runbook.
- Dev: share MAP draft + MSA redline bullets with Alice by EOD 2029-07-06. Link to internal draft: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/AC-8421
- Neha / AE: prep pricing slide for procurement (dedicated vs shared-dedicated) — include the standby fee and activation delta.

Alice — we will include the 750ms P99 target in the MAP and flag quantized-8 as an explicit fallback that requires a short quality eval (we'll propose a 48-hour acceptance window inside the MAP).

Ben confirmed he has the runbook and snapshot; attaching the runbook PDF and fleet snapshot for the thread (see ops attachments).

If everyone is aligned I will mark the HubSpot deal stage as "POC-ready — standby placed" once Ben confirms the tag.

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales, Dedicated Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: runbook_gpu_hold_v1.pdf, fleet_snapshot_20290705.csv
